source.title: Unable to restore item using item restoration webpage — Heart of Wind (Mythic)
source.author: Advil-3400117

notes: Original player identifies Heart of Wind (Mythic) as the item to be restored on April 28. The restoration request involves a Dawn Crystal and Swirling Arcane Essence; on April 30 the author reports the restoration succeeded after possessing both crystal quality ranks. This is ONE INDIRECT disenchant-restoration event, not a direct loot/event log, so it corroborates apparent disenchantability of the Mythic variant only. Source says one rank-1 crystal was in inventory, but its presence does not prove the original item's crystal rank; the restoration UI did not show the rank and item bonus IDs/actual ilvl are unknown. The single Dawn Crystal reclamation unit is inferred from the one-item restoration requirement, NOT an independently captured output; use conservatively and do not infer population probabilities. The author also reports one Swirling Arcane Essence in bags, not an independently attributable event-level knowledge item. Item 250256 (Heart of Wind, epic trinket) corroborated by https://www.wowhead.com/item=250256/heart-of-wind ; no assumption about a specific Mythic ilvl/upgrade track, enchant skill or specialization. Screenshot https://imgur.com/a/JIfEbuK was linked but unavailable for independent inspection. Do not pool with the distinct Mantle of Dark Devotion 251085 restoration cohort. Cross-checked earlier Midnight looter/eligibility files, without a matching original URL or item ID in sampled files.
